STORAGE_CONSENT_STRINGS.body: Zettacard remembers your learning progress (e.g. profiles, spaced-repetition progress, starred/seen questions, completed exams) plus your language and theme, only on this device — not as a cookie, but as browser "local storage". If you agree, we save one small technical flag so this notice doesn't show again. If you decline, nothing is saved (anything already stored is cleared), and this notice reappears next time.
STORAGE_CONSENT_STRINGS.timeoutNote: If you don't choose, this notice disappears in 10 seconds — that counts as declining, and your progress won't be saved.
